hook: A diver drifted away from his boat 75 miles offshore.
narration: This diver drifted away from his boat, seventy five miles off Myrtle Beach.
His boat crew set off their emergency GPS beacon, and a Coast Guard helicopter from Savannah flew out to find him.
A beacon like that sends its position by satellite, so rescuers know exactly where to search.
The rescue swimmer dropped into the water first. Then the crew lowered a basket.
The pilots cannot see straight down, so the flight mechanic talks them over the basket. [short pause] Forward and right.
With the diver inside, the basket started up toward the door.
outcome: The Savannah aircrew brought the diver into the helicopter, then hoisted their swimmer back up.
title: Diver adrift 75 miles off Myrtle Beach
description:
A Coast Guard Air Station Savannah aircrew rescued a diver who drifted away from his boat 75 miles off Myrtle Beach, South Carolina, on June 1, 2024, after his boat crew activated their emergency GPS beacon.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Coast Guard Air Station Savannah, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/925835/coast-guard-rescues-diver-75-miles-offshore-myrtle-beach
